eyes close and head begins to nod while the F07-authority paired lower body holds
quiet inhale midpoint
breathing returns toward neutral before interruption
sleepy gaze focuses and the rubbing hand begins to lift
hand releases the eye and travels toward the mouth
yawn closes, hand lowers and feet begin drawing inward
half-rise with knees extending and dress falling
eyelids lower further and knees just begin to flex
deepening bend immediately before first seated contact
hands settle toward the lap while the F07-authority paired lower body holds
hands finish settling and chin lowers into sleep with the same paired lower body
shoulders start the inhale rise
inhale eases toward the opposite breathing key
exhale settles with tiny rabbit-ear delay
near-neutral sleep immediately before eyes open
small second eye-rub beat before release
hips lift and weight transfers through both feet
hands clear the face and feet accept initial load
nearly upright, posture composes toward neutral
torso rises while satchel descends to standing side

hard_rules: Each missing frame is one independently generated complete character drawing.
Never use interpolation, optical flow, morphing, cross-fade, warping, translated parts or compositing.
The canonical model sheet remains the design authority in every generation call.
Use the accepted pose-family authority and both nearest accepted temporal bounds.
Reject failed frames before they can become temporal references.
